Strategic report: Sustainability and ESG
In 2023 our Scope 1 emissions were 182,400 tCO2e and Scope 2 (market-based) emissions were
96,300 tCO2e, a 14% reduction versus 2022. Scope 3 emissions were 2.1 million tCO2e. Renewable
electricity accounted for 62% of consumption. Total water withdrawal was 3.4 million m3 and waste
diverted from landfill reached 81%. We report in accordance with GRI Standards and the TCFD
recommendations, and have submitted our climate disclosure to CDP. Our target is net zero by 2040
with an interim 50% reduction by 2030 against a 2019 baseline. In 2023 our Scope 1 emissions were

Our people
Total workforce was 18,250 employees; women represented 41% of employees and 33% of senior
management. The lost time injury frequency rate (LTIFR) was 0.62 per million hours worked and there
were zero fatalities. Average training was 24 hours per employee. Employee turnover was 11%. We

Corporate governance report
The board comprises 10 directors of whom 7 are independent non-executive directors; 40% of the
board are women. The audit committee met six times. Executive remuneration includes ESG-linked
performance metrics weighted at 15%. Our code of conduct and anti-corruption policy apply to all
employees and suppliers; 100% of employees completed ethics training. No material data breaches
